proposed_attachment: Existing M5 dataset.jsonl -> model_candidate.inputs[].features.history; no parallel datastore or runtime integration in this PR
compatibility: Existing M6 HISTORY_FEATURE_CONTRACT_NOT_VALIDATED remains unchanged and enforced
identity: Preserve original registration/TMP and namespace. Name or start number alone is insufficient. Retrospective ATG identity proof does not automatically establish pre-race identity/PIT.
labels: Official results are a separate RETROSPECTIVE_LABEL_ONLY evidence layer. A 2026 fetch of a 2015 outcome may be a retrospective label; it never proves 2015 pre-race input availability.
evidence_quarantine: Original raw history lines may contain odds/prizes. Retain as evidence, never pass raw text, market columns or target outcomes as fundamental features.
race_level_rule: Any future training candidate requires verified full fields, stable horse/race IDs, independent result truth, PIT-correct approved inputs for every runner and explicit exclusions. Sixty diagnostic observations do not meet this requirement.

allowed_use_vocabulary.RESEARCH_ONLY: Only use assigned by this proposal
allowed_use_vocabulary.SHADOW_CANDIDATE: Future explicit validation/governance prerequisite; not assigned here
allowed_use_vocabulary.MODEL_ELIGIBLE: Never assigned by this delivery; separate data/model admission required

historical_date.source_and_identity_requirements: Original PDF date token and uniquely attributed horse block
historical_date.cutoff: Historical event precedes target analysis cutoff; actual feature availability must be strictly before cutoff, all timestamps aware; same-day date-only history excluded
historical_date.pit_verification: Documented publication or conservative direct observation upper bound for this exact source fact and verified horse/race identity before cutoff; retrieval of a retrospective result is not proof of earlier feature availability
